user_authorization: 2026-10-18: 差不多了可以开始测试了；主线优化Goose拖拽能力，尤其硬件
purpose: Use bounded pure-contact drag evidence to decide Goose mouth, neck, contact and actuator hardware improvements. Stop exterior refinement. Not a long training project.
prerequisite: G final limited static acceptance of R4/004 before physics integration; preparation can start immediately. Stop on identity/contact/closure preflight failure.

payload.assembly: Free physical box placed on actual deck; full box inertia from dimensions. No weld or virtual attachment to cart/robot.
payload.target_total_mass_note: 20kg cargo plus native cart estimate, approximately27.815342kg for R4, not20kg total.

conditions.contact_values_status: Design assumptions, not measured material calibration; log actual pair values and mixing. Never silently lower friction.
conditions.resistance_model: If using wheel frictionloss, expose variant and map torque from force*wheel_radius/4; baseline XML remains immutable. Declared equivalent level-floor resistance probe, not calibrated casters or arbitrary low friction. Account actual startup and wheel speed.
conditions.motion_goal: For local hardware probe, slow actual neck retraction over about50mm, grip then pull then hold; no fixture motion. Free-base run only if local gates pass; separate from local results.
conditions.primary_matched_comparison: R4 vs historical R2 at same20kg payload,8N equivalent cart resistance, original robot drive/contact limits; respective real bite poses and passive drawhead gravity retained.

allowed_sequence: Read old Pickup/drag harnesses as history; write fresh non-overwriting pilot, never execute old serve or output paths.
Preflight immutable sources, true clamp point, full loaded geometry, contact penetration, axes, actuator adapter/200Hz physics and50Hz commands.
Local fixed-torso hardware bench: head/neck/mouth remain actuated; free loaded cart and cargo; physical clamp only. Compare R4 with R2 under8N resistance.
If nominal clamp/traction is sound, use one20N equivalent resistance attempt to expose slip or torque boundary; otherwise spend attempt on the observed failure countercheck.

If local gate passes, one free-base loaded posture/traction-start probe with existing bounded control. No root/foot fixture, no pose writes, no object binding. A neck-only cart displacement is not whole-body backward hauling.
Use remaining attempt only for a repeat near the boundary or a meaningful zero-drive/zero-friction countercheck; no matrix expansion.
invariants: Original53 robot files, full mass/COM/inertia, axes, closed-loop, limits, drive capabilities,350W design budget and disabled peaks remain immutable.
No robot-object weld, suction, direct object teleportation or online qpos writeback. Only declared initialization/reset.
A local torso fixture is allowed solely in a prominently labelled bench. Head must not be fixed; no fixture in free-base trial.
Do not modify Sai_Lab V0.1 Picking, Move, Standup, G1, default assets or task/reward/observation/action contracts.
No new CAD/hardware version during run; report a hardware candidate only after evidence review.
measurements: actual jaw and cart contact forces, transferred towing force, slip/roll-out/drop and contact penetration
cart/cargo/root displacement and velocity, support mode and body tilt, per-foot contact and slip
per-axis applied torque, velocity, power, saturation duty, closure residuals, warnings and actual effective timing
passive pitch/roll/yaw motion, tongue load, cargo support on deck, caster/wheel motion and effective resisting force
continuous trajectory and original-speed video for each attempt, reproducible input/config/controller identity and resource receipt

success_scope.local: Exploratory: continuous genuine grasp through slow pull and>=5s holding at declared resistance; no roll-out/drop, no hidden support, applied limits respected. Report slip/angle rather than claiming reliability from<=5 trials.
success_scope.free: Exploratory posture/traction-start only. Track robot backward displacement separately. Cannot qualify0.5m/60s, whole dragging skill,20kg operational reliability or cross-engine ability.
success_scope.failure_classification: Distinguish contact/geometry/actuator evidence from control inadequacy or unknown. A fall under unvalidated control alone is not hardware capacity proof.

abort_conditions: Initial unclassified penetration>0.5mm or invalid closure/axes/NaN
Sustained free-base body tilt>25deg or loss of support; preserve failure then stop attempt
Source immutability breach or exceeding resources; return partial evidence immediately
return_required: Actual attempt table, success/failure videos and all immutable source hashes
Step logs and reproducible fresh harness/config, applied torque/force evidence, any control prerequisites or blockers
One hardware question answered and next proposed test or minimum hardware change; do not make an unsupported maximum-load claim
